reviews.text: I love the availability. They never make me wait for weeks before I can get in.  They really care about my animals and there health. I could no ask for anything better. Such a great place.

We have been going to Nordhoff vet with our kitties for a while now. We are happy with the care they provide. Dr Popescu and Dr Cohen are great. Our cats have been seen and taken care of by both of them. Front desk ladies are always nice and try their best to accommodate. Prices are comparable. Facility is clean. I’m happy my babies are taken care of when we come and that we found such a great veterinary office with wonderful staff/front desk/doctors! Thank you all :-)
The Doctors and staff are always courteous and helpful. Phone calls are returned promptly and when promised. They will go the extra mile to make sure you and your pet are comfortable.

Nordhoff vet hospital did a wonderful job taking care of our princess midnight she was a wonderful dog 🐕 ❤️.  I recommend this place anyone looking a place thats honest,  helpful and understand compassion.

We are incredibly grateful to everyone at Nordhoff Veterinary Hospital for taking such wonderful care of our cat over the past few years.

A special thank you to Dr. Popescu and Dr. Cohen for their care, compassion, and patience. Both doctors always took the time to explain everything clearly and answer all of our questions. We never felt rushed, and that meant so much to us, especially during some very difficult moments.

The entire team has been wonderful. The nurses have been caring and attentive, the front desk staff have always been incredibly kind and responsive, and everyone has consistently gone above and beyond to help us and make sure Bradley was cared for.

Nordhoff Veterinary Hospital is truly a wonderful place to take your pets. We are very grateful for everything they have done for for our family. Thank you all.

I had a very upsetting and disappointing experience at this veterinary hospital with my 15-year-old cat.

I arrived approximately 10 minutes late and was told that, because I was late, I could no longer accompany my cat during the appointment. They took my elderly, sick cat into the back without me, despite my explaining how stressful this was for both of us. At 15 years old and while not feeling well, he needed compassion and reassurance—not to be separated from me unnecessarily.

I was also extremely uncomfortable with the direction of the visit. I came in because my cat was sick and wanted his immediate symptoms evaluated and treated, including discussing whether antibiotics were appropriate. Instead, I felt pressured about updating vaccinations before they would proceed with care. They also proposed an invasive procedure that I was not comfortable authorizing at that point.

Eventually, I reminded myself that I am my cat’s advocate and that I have the right to ask questions and decline procedures I am not comfortable with. I picked him up and left.

Thankfully, I found another veterinarian in Topanga who approached my elderly cat with much more compassion, listened to my concerns, and focused on what he needed at that moment.

I understand that veterinary practices have policies and that arriving late can affect their schedule. But I believe there should also be room for compassion and reasonable judgment—especially when dealing with a sick, 15-year-old animal and a worried owner. I left feeling that policies, vaccinations, and procedures were being prioritized over listening to me and considering the emotional well-being of my elderly cat.

Unfortunately, based on this experience, I would not return.

Been taking our two cats 😽😽 here for 7+ years. Dr. Popescu & Dr. Cohen and the Nordhoff Vet staff are all very professional. Doctors always take their time with both cats' exams and we feel thoroughly comfortable with them. Our female cat has been pretty relaxed during her exams (and she can be very fussy). We've taken both kitties in for their dental cleanings twice and both times all went very well. Definitely recommend Nordhoff Vet to other pet parents.
The staff is so helpful and easy parking. The place is clean.
Lovely people who really care about animals!!
These guys take fantastic care of our cat and 2 dogs.  We're so grateful to have them!
Wonderful animal hospital! The Best

I want to give a special shout-out to Jennifer and all of the wonderful doctors and staff at Nordhoff Veterinary Hospital.
Every visit, we are met with kindness, patience, and genuine care — not only for my cats, but for me as well. The team consistently treats my babies with compassion and respect, and it truly shows how much they love what they do. Knowing my pets are in the hands of people who care so deeply brings an incredible sense of comfort and trust.
I sincerely appreciate everything Jennifer and the doctors have done for my cats over the years. Their dedication and warmth never go unnoticed, and I truly would not dream of going anywhere else for my cats’ care.
Thank you for always taking such amazing care of my family.

I cannot thank Nordhoff Veterinary Hospital enough, especially Jennifer for helping save my dog Stormi’s life.

Stormi was bitten by a rattlesnake while we were on a hike, and I was completely panicked, and I am not the easiest to deal with when I’m panicked. I called their office and Jennifer answered. She immediately calmed me down, reassured me, and guided me through each step on what to do. She directed me to the appropriate emergency animal hospital, called ahead, and made sure everything was ready for Stormi before we even arrived even sent over her records.
In one of the most terrifying moments of my life, Jennifer was calm, compassionate, and incredibly helpful. Her quick thinking and genuine care made all the difference.
This office truly cares about their patients and their families I have been going here for over 4 years with all 3 of my dogs and forever will. I am beyond grateful. Thank you again for everything you did for Stormi. My best friend is home with Me.

I would like to note that Jennifer and the team did not have to go to the extent they did, but they did this truly shows the team they all are.

I love the vets and staff at this local hospital. Ive brought my fur babies a few times and they always come through for my girls and their anxious worried momma (me). Thank you so much to the entire team for all your hard work.
Dr. Popescu and her technicians are Amazing!!!  I wouldn't go anywhere else!!  The entire crew are world class!!!

Dr. Popescu is professional and empathetic and kind, as is Dr. Cohen.
All the techs love animals and make my dog feel comfortable in an anxious situation. Front office Cindy, Jennifer and Hanah are terrific and always kind and helpful.

I had to update my review after a few years. My family and I have been going to Nordhoff Vet for years now.  The staff is amazing.

Professionalism, experience, but the kindness is what separates them to me. Most people who work with animals are kind but I was truly touched with the entire team here when my dog Teddy was sick and ultimately passed.

❤️Dr. Cohen❤️ and all the techs and receptionists (Jennifer❤️) went above and beyond to provide me with comfort during an impossible situation. Dr. Cohen is hands down the best vet I’ve experienced. She is incredibly smart, pragmatic and equally caring.  I drive from West Hollywood to come here which if you know LA is wild.

This place has earned a lifetime of loyalty from me for the way they run their practice and the people they hire.
Good service attitude and high service quality

I feel like I found a secret treasure in the Veterinary world. Nordhoff Vet is simply the best!! Jennifer and Courtney greet you with such positivity and kindness and know you and your pet. Dr. P is patient, knowledgeable, professional, and passionate. All of the tech staff are kind and show my dog a lot of love and care. The entire team does. It’s hands down the best Vet I have taken my animals to. So grateful I found this place! Thank you Nordhoff Vet staff for taking such good care of my pup.

Jennifer helped me make the best decision for my pet

She is professional, kind and invested in your pets future

If Jennifer is there, I highly recommend

Absolutely the most caring Veterinary experience we’ve ever had. In a world where taking care of your beloved pet can cost an arm and a leg, we received advice that was not only comforting but also care that was not centered around making a buck! The focus was the well being of our dog and we’ll forever be grateful and loyal.

Absolutely love Nordoff Vet! We’ve been taking our dogs and cats here for years.  The staff is ALWAYS friendly and attentive, the techs are super knowledgeable and great, and the doctors have always listened.  Highly recommend Nordoff Vet!
Wonderful staff, always caring about about yourself and pets.  From being welcomed by Hannah and the other kind people at the front desk to Dr. Cohen and all the vet techs.
They do a great job taking care of Mimi & Magu!

I've been taking my pup to them for years. They are very professional and have never tried to oversell me, and they referred me to a specialist when an issue was out of their area of expertise. Everyone in the office is extremely kind, and I can't recommend them highly enough.

The doctors and staff here were incredible at helping my fur baby out and making sure he got all the care he needed. They are very punctual with calling and texting with updates and well as checking in after a few days to make sure everything is still okay. I will definitely keep coming back with my cat.
We appreciate the clear, direct, and respectful care provided by the staff today, especially by Dr. Cohen. Grogu and I are thankful for your expertise and kindness.
Great place and amazing staff.
We have been coming here for the last 8 years and I can confidently recommend this facility 10/10. They are the best! Thank you for your exceptional service and care for my pup through the years.

I had an emergency with my cat over the weekend, and I was so grateful that this clinic was able to see us right away. The team was incredibly professional and kind, quickly diagnosing the issue. What really stood out was how they found ways to help me save money without compromising on the care my cat received. I couldn’t be happier with the service and highly recommend them for anyone in need of reliable, compassionate pet care!
Amazing staff, communicative, they always respond back to you timely and overall they take great care of our cat. ❤️
My two dogs are always treated kindly and with care. I trust the service providers here at this Vet clinic. Dr. Cohen is super sweet and offers such a delicate approach to sensitive dogs. Thank you!

From the front desk to all the doctors and assistants this is the place to bring your pet!  They may be a little more expensive but it's worth it! You will be happy with the love and kindness you and your pet will receive.
Nordhoff Veterinary Hospital is wonderful.  My dog, Layla, has received the best care.  The entire staff is caring, compassionate, and kind.
